pr_comments: I see `SetNetworkCookieParam` also exists within '@playwright-core/client/network'. is there a better way to re-use that instead?

issue_context.title: [Feature] improved typescript definitions for `BrowserContext.addCookies`
comments: I see no difference between the current implementation and your proposed changes in https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/13238. What is the use-case or what are you trying to achieve?

You can do the following, would that work for you?

```ts
import { BrowserContext } from '@playwright/test'
type Cookie = Parameters<BrowserContext['addCookies']>[0][number];
```
reference: https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/utility-types.html#parameterstype
Oh that's perfect thanks so much - I appreciate your help here. I wasn't aware of using `Parameters`.
